_meta.topic: Anthropic Claude Sonnet 5 system card deep mine (§3 Cyber + §4 Safeguards + §8 Capabilities) + Meituan LongCat 2.0 release
_meta.notes: Sonnet 5 = upgrade to Sonnet 4.6. RSP determination: does NOT cross AI R&D threshold (less capable than Mythos 5 on every automated eval); CB-1/CB-2 bio/chem uplift limited; cyber NOT optimized (safeguards similar to Opus 4.7/4.8). Hallucination + sycophancy markedly improved vs Sonnet 4.6; verbalized evaluation awareness significantly higher. First model to criticize its Constitution's hard-constraint rule. **CRITICAL EVENT noted in §4.1.3**: Mythos 5 and Fable 5 were 'de-deployed in response to the US government's export control directive' — not yet reflected in our model status flags. LongCat 2.0 = 1.6T total / ~48B active MoE, pretrained on 35T tokens over 50K+ AI ASICs (alternative hardware to NVIDIA), 1M-context native, MIT-style open weights. LongCat Sparse Attention (LSA) evolution of DeepSeek Sparse Attention. N-gram Embedding (135B params, n-gram=5).
